description: This file defines a utility class `ProductWorker` in the OFBiz framework, providing static methods for product-related operations such as shipping applicability, address authorization, inventory checks, feature management, product variant handling, and calculations related to products and their configurations.

classes.name: ProductWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to facilitate product-related operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: shippingApplies
methods.description: Determines if shipping charges apply to a given product based on its type and digital/physical status.

methods.name: isBillableToAddress
methods.description: Checks if a product can be billed to a specific postal address.

methods.name: isShippableToAddress
methods.description: Checks if a product can be shipped to a specific postal address.

methods.name: isAllowedToAddress
methods.description: Internal method to determine address allowance based on geographic restrictions.

methods.name: isSerialized
methods.description: Checks if a product is serialized based on its inventory type.

methods.name: taxApplies
methods.description: Indicates whether tax applies to a product.

methods.name: getInstanceAggregatedId
methods.description: Retrieves the aggregated product ID for a given product instance if it's of an aggregated type.

methods.name: getAggregatedInstanceId
methods.description: Finds the specific instance ID within an aggregated product, given the aggregate ID and configuration.

methods.name: getAggregatedAssocs
methods.description: Gets associations related to an aggregated product.

methods.name: getVariantVirtualId
methods.description: Returns the virtual ID associated with a product variant.

methods.name: getVariantVirtualAssocs
methods.description: Retrieves associations for a variant product related to virtual products.

methods.name: isProductInventoryAvailableByFacility
methods.description: Checks inventory availability for a product at a specified facility.

methods.name: isProductInventoryAvailableByFacility
methods.description: Checks inventory for multiple component products based on their configuration options.

methods.name: getVariantDistinguishingFeatures
methods.description: Returns key features that distinguish a variant product.

methods.name: getGwpAlternativeOptionName
methods.description: Generates a user-visible name for GWP (Gift With Purchase) alternatives based on variant features.

methods.name: getProductFeaturesByApplTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves product features applying a given type ID for a product or product ID.

methods.name: getProductFeaturesApplIncludeMarketingPackage
methods.description: Retrieves features included in a marketing package, considering product associations.

methods.name: getProductVirtualVariantMethod
methods.description: Returns the virtual variant method mode for a product.

methods.name: getSelectableProductFeaturesByTypesAndSeq
methods.description: Returns a list of selectable features grouped by feature type and sequence, for building UI options.

methods.name: getVariantSelectionFeatures
methods.description: Returns features required to select a specific variant of a product.

methods.name: getOptionalProductFeatures
methods.description: Returns a map of optional features grouped by feature type for a given product.

methods.name: calcOrderAdjustments
methods.description: Calculates total order adjustments including tax, shipping, and other adjustments.

methods.name: calcOrderAdjustment
methods.description: Calculates a single adjustment amount based on a adjustment record.

methods.name: filterOrderAdjustments
methods.description: Filters order adjustments by type and inclusion flags for tax, shipping, and others.

methods.name: getAverageProductRating
methods.description: Calculates the average rating for a product, considering reviews and configuration.

methods.name: getCurrentProductCategories
methods.description: Retrieves current categories associated with a product.

methods.name: getParentProduct
methods.description: Finds the parent product for a variant, if any.

methods.name: isDigital
methods.description: Indicates whether a product is digital based on its product type.

methods.name: isPhysical
methods.description: Indicates whether a product is physical based on its product type.

methods.name: isVirtual
methods.description: Checks if a product is virtual.

methods.name: isAmountRequired
methods.description: Checks if an amount is required for a product (likely in the context of certain configuration or processing).

methods.name: getProductTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves the product type ID of a product.

methods.name: getProductWeight
methods.description: Calculates the weight of a product, possibly summing components and converting units as needed.

methods.name: findProductsById
methods.description: Searches for products by ID, with options for broadness and type filtering.

methods.name: findProductId
methods.description: Finds a single product ID based on search parameters.

methods.name: findProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a product entity matching given search criteria.

methods.name: findProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product entities matching given search criteria.

methods.name: isSellable
methods.description: Determines if a product is sellable at a given timestamp.

methods.name: getRefurbishedProductIdSet
methods.description: Returns a set of related refurbished product IDs.

methods.name: getVariantFromFeatureTree
methods.description: Determines the variant product ID based on selected features, possibly creating a new variant on-demand.

methods.name: isAlternativePacking
methods.description: Determines if a product is an alternative packing for another product or virtual variant.

methods.name: getOriginalProductId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the original product for an alternative packing or variant.
